## Resolved & Verified Items

* [x] **[BUG-001] [S2-Prevented] Audio Autoplay Policy Block**: Web browsers block unprompted autoplay with sound.
  * *Resolution*: Feed defaults to `muted={true}` with prominent top-right audio pill toggle. Tap-to-unmute seamlessly unlocks audio for the active session.
* [x] **[BUG-002] [S3-Prevented] Empty Comment Submission**: Pressing Enter with blank space could pollute thread.
  * *Resolution*: Disabled state enforced on submit button (`!commentInput.trim()`).
